questions.question_text: Complete the statements. A rhombus has rotational symmetry of order ...................... A parallelogram has ...................... lines of symmetry.
Convert 0.027 kilometres into centimetres.
Calculate \u221b{1 - \frac{2.7}{3.5}}. Give your answer correct to 4 significant figures.
In the diagram, CA = CB and ABE is a straight line. Find the value of x.
Solve. 0 = 4x - 11
Calculate the value of w.
Write down the type of correlation between the time Omar spent revising and his test score.
Find the equation of the regression line for y in terms of x.
Use your answer to part (b)(i) to estimate Omar\u2019s test score when he spends 20 minutes revising.
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f(x) for values of x between -3 and 3.
Find the zero of f(x).
Find the equation of the asymptote to the graph.
Find the coordinates of the local maximum point.
The equation f(x) = k has one solution. Find the range of values of k.
The volume of a sphere is 96.5 cm3. Calculate the radius of the sphere.
The speed of each of 155 cars passing a school gate is recorded. The results are shown in the table. Calculate an estimate of the mean speed.
PQ = \begin{pmatrix} 5 \\ -4 \end{pmatrix}. Find |PQ|.
w \u221d \u221a{x + 1}. When x = 3, w = 8. Find x when w = 20.
A solid is formed from a cone and a hemisphere. The cone and the hemisphere each have a radius of 6 cm. The cone has a height of 15 cm. Find the volume of the solid.
Write down an expression, in terms of x, for the number of apples she buys.
Factorise 13x^2 - 710x - 4200.
Find the cost of one orange.
Calculate the value of y.
Use set notation to describe the shaded region.
Shade P \u2229 Q'.
Find f(-2).
Find x when f(x) = 6.
Find fg(x). Give your answer in its simplest form.
Find g^{-1}(x).

Bruce buys a new car on 1 January 2022. On 1 January 2023 the value of the car has decreased by 20%. On 1 January 2024 the value of the car has decreased by 15% of its value on 1 January 2023. Find the overall percentage decrease in the value of the car on 1 January 2024.

Sangita buys a car with a value of $20000. The value of the car decreases exponentially at a rate of 5% per year. Calculate the number of complete years it will take for the value of the car to decrease from $20000 to $8000.
Sunil buys a car. The value of the car decreases exponentially at a rate of 6% per year. At the end of 9 years the value of the car is $8022. Calculate the original value of the car.

The two solids are mathematically similar. The volume of the large solid is 416 cm3. The volume of the small solid is 52 cm3. The total surface area of the small solid is 60 cm2. Calculate the total surface area of the large solid.
Simplify. \frac{3x - 5}{3xy - 3x - 5y + 5}
A is the point (-2, 8) and B is the point (1, 9). The perpendicular bisector of the line AB meets the x-axis at the point P. Find the coordinates of the point P.
